item.subject: science
item.stem: During a science class in Meerut, Riya looks at a drop of pond water under the microscope and sees a single-celled Amoeba moving and feeding on its own. Her classmate Arjun says, “It has only one cell, so it cannot be a complete living organism.” Which statement is correct?

options.A: Arjun is correct, because every living organism must be made of many cells.
options.B: Riya is correct to disagree, because the single cell of an Amoeba carries out all life processes, so it is a complete organism.
options.C: Arjun is correct, because unicellular organisms can feed but cannot reproduce on their own.
options.D: Neither is correct, because an Amoeba becomes a complete organism only after joining with other cells.
